error[ZC-E0812]: a certificate names another server than the one asked for
  cause  broker.botpike.com's certificate names other.botpike.com, not
         broker.botpike.com
  fix    connect to the name the certificate is for, or issue the server a certificate for the name asked for
  more   zcube explain E0812 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0812.html
